name: Check whether a service is running
description: A read-only terminal check: inspect the service status and confirm the result yourself. Nothing is installed, changed or restarted.
objective: Check why nginx is not responding

steps.title: Inspect the service status
steps.instruction: Run this read-only status check in a terminal and look for 'active (running)' or an error.
steps.expected_result: The status line reports active (running), or names the failure reason.
steps.why: Reading the status explains the failure without changing anything.

steps.title: Read the recent log lines
steps.instruction: Run this read-only log query and read the last lines for the error.
steps.expected_result: The log shows the cause of the failure (port in use, permission denied, config error).
steps.why: The log usually names the exact cause; guessing at fixes wastes time.
